features.label: Controlled range of motion
features.text: Polycentric hinges allow for precise management of flexion and extension to protect healing tissue.

features.label: Customizable hinge arms
features.text: Rigid hinge arms are malleable and can be contoured to your leg’s unique shape for a secure fit.

features.label: Cooltech breathable fabric
features.text: Advanced antimicrobial material reduces heat and moisture build-up for comfortable all-day wear.

features.label: Open popliteal design
features.text: The open area behind the knee prevents material bunching and skin irritation during movement.

indications: Mild to moderate ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL tears
measurement: Measure your thigh circumference 6 in. above the mid-patella with your leg straight. This brace features a universal design that fits both the left and right leg.
